newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on budget skepticism.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on budget skepticism.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower on Monday, with investors critical of the new budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June) selling shares, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index slipped 24.86 points, or 2.16 percent, to 1,123.25 on turnover of 54.7 million taka ($1.3 million). Losers led gainers by 106 to 22.
"There is nothing in the proposed budget that can bolster the market sentiment. The bearish trend may continue for another couple of days," said one broker.
Leasing company IDLC lost 46 taka to 2,216, Bangladesh Lamps fell 24 to 4,953 and Tulip Dairy gained 20 to 221.
